description: Input for tools/build-toc. Wayfinder.toc is generated from upstream's RXPGuides.toc: the file lines that load for gameType, minus 'drop', plus our own files from 'insert' (each written right after its 'after' line, in list order), under the header below. Header values are written in this order; the value "inherit" copies upstream's line unchanged. Upstream metadata not named here (X-*, Interface-*, Title-*, Category*) is not carried over.

header.Title: Wayfinder
header.Notes: Leveling guide for WoW: Forever. Based on RestedXP Guides (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
header.Author: Wayfinder contributors

drop.reason: Cpt. Stadics' Vendor Treasures is CC BY-NC 3.0 third-party Classic vendor data; owner decided 2026-11-17 not to ship it. Every caller already checks addon.VendorTreasures.

Hearthstone batching hooks item-use and spell-cast functions at file load and calls ConfirmBinder() from an OnUpdate script without a player click (UPSTREAM_MAP B18 A3/H1); owner approved removal 2026-11-17. Its options and batchSize default are removed from SettingsPanel.lua; addon.isCastingHS is now always nil (read nil-safely in Targeting.lua).

insert.reason: Menu adapter replacing LibUIDropDownMenu (GPL); loads before RXPGuides.lua, whose addon:ShowMenu/CloseMenu call it.
Own minimap button replacing LibDataBroker-1.1 + LibDBIcon-1.0; loads before SettingsPanel.lua, whose UpdateMinimapButton calls it.
